description: ACTON, Mass. (Oct. 7, 2018) — Democratic state Sen. Jamie Eldridge of Acton today endorsed Lori Trahan, Democrat for Congress in the Third District. Eldridge, the state senator for the Middlesex and Worcester District, was joined by state Rep. Jen Benson (D-Lunenburg). He said Trahan is committed to the issues that will continue to move […]

title: Representative Lori Trahan Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
